description_en: Updates the information about an API in the development state in DataService Studio
description_zh: 调用UpdateDataServiceApi更新数据服务API开发态的信息
name: UpdateDataServiceApi

parameters.help_en: The tenant ID. To obtain the tenant ID, perform the following steps: Log on to the DataWorks console (https://workbench.data.aliyun.com/console). Find your workspace and go to the DataStudio page. On the DataStudio page, click the username for the logon in the upper-right corner and click User Info in the Menu section
parameters.help_zh: 租户ID。您可登录DataWorks控制台 (https://workbench.data.aliyun.com/console)，进入数据开发（DataStudio）页面，单击右上方当前登录用户名称，选择菜单 > 用户信息，获取租户ID
parameters.name: tenant_id

parameters.help_en: The request method of the API. Valid values: 0, 1, 2, and 3. The value 0 indicates the GET method. The value 1 indicates the POST method. The value 2 indicates the PUT method. The value 3 indicates the DELETE method. APIs generated in wizard or script mode support the GET and POST methods. APIs generated by registration support the GET, POST, PUT, and DELETE methods
parameters.help_zh: API的请求方式，可选枚举值包括0（GET）、1（POST）、2（PUT）和3（DELTE）。向导和脚本API支持GET和POST。注册API支持GET、POST、PUT和DELETE
parameters.name: request_method

parameters.help_en: The format in which the response of the API request is returned. Valid values: 0 and 1. The value 0 indicates the JSON format. The value 1 indicates the XML format. APIs generated in wizard or script mode support the JSON format. APIs generated by registration support the JSON and XML formats
parameters.help_zh: API的返回数据类型，可选枚举值包括0（JSON）和1（XML）。向导和脚本API支持JSON，注册API支持JSON和XML
parameters.name: response_content_type

parameters.help_en: The timeout period of the API request. Unit: milliseconds. Valid values: (0,30000]
parameters.help_zh: 超时时间，单位为毫秒（ms），取值范围为(0, 30000]
parameters.name: timeout

parameters.help_en: The scope in which the API is visible. Valid values: 0 and 1. The value 0 indicates that the API is visible within the workspace. The value 1 indicates that the API is visible only to its owner
parameters.help_zh: 可见范围，可选枚举值包括0（工作空间）和1（私有）
parameters.name: visible_range

parameters.help_en: The protocol used by the API. Valid values: 0 and 1. The value 0 indicates HTTP. The value 1 indicates HTTPS. You can specify multiple protocols. Separate multiple protocols with commas (,)
parameters.help_zh: API协议，可选枚举值包括0（HTTP）和1（HTTPS）。支持多值，多个值之间使用英文逗号（,）分隔
parameters.name: protocols

parameters.help_en: The details of the API generated in wizard mode. For more information, see the WizardDetails parameter returned by the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/174013.html operation
parameters.help_zh: 向导API的详情，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/174013.html接口wizardDetails字段的JSON String
parameters.name: wizard_details

parameters.help_en: The details of the API generated in script mode. For more information, see the ScriptDetails parameter returned by the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/174013.html operation
parameters.help_zh: 脚本API的详情，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/174013.html接口scriptDetails字段的JSON String
parameters.name: script_details

parameters.help_en: The details of the API generated by registration. For more information, see the RegistrationDetails parameter returned by the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/174013.html operation
parameters.help_zh: 注册API的详情，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/174013.html接口registrationDetails字段的JSON String
parameters.name: registration_details

parameters.help_en: The ID of the exclusive resource group
parameters.name: resource_group_id

Data.description_en: Indicates whether the information about the API was updated

RequestId.description_zh: 请求ID，一次请求的唯一标识

Success.description_en: Indicates whether the request was successful
